sections.title: باب 6 — متن (14)

paras.text: … played. The private channels of Pakistan supported the public and encouraged them. The media played a role to the point of perfection in the awakening of people in every field. The success of any political system depends on the active role of political parties. In Pakistan most political parties did not play their legitimate role which they should have played. The result was that in place of political parties social movements rose and filled this gap. Sometimes political governments adopted an undemocratic course, and movements started against this conduct.

The success of any political system depends on the active role of political parties. In Pakistan most political parties did not play their legitimate role which they should have played. The result was that in place of political parties social movements rose and filled this gap. Sometimes political governments adopted an undemocratic course, and movements started against this conduct.

2. Economic Causes

Economic reasons too are an important cause of the activity of social movements in Pakistan. In Pakistan the gap between rich and poor is increasing. In reaction to this, movements of a socialist nature were born. Industrial development too gave birth to many organisations and movements. Labourers raised their voice for their rights and adopted the form of movements. Different professional groups made organisations to achieve group interests, and sometimes these organisations, uniting for common interests, adopted the form of a big movement.

3. Religious Causes

In Pakistan movements raised their heads for religious revival and constitutional reforms, for example the Tehreek-e-Nizam-e-Mustafa, Tehreek-e-Islami, the Sunni Ittehad Tehreek, the Tehreek-e-Khatm-e-Nabuwwat (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) and the Tablighi movement etc. Recently religious parties, religious organisations and ulema have started a movement in the name of the Difa-e-Pakistan Council.

4. Other Causes

paras.urdu: مقامی سطح پر امن کے فروغ کے طریقے (Ways of Promoting Peace at Local Level)
paras.pashto: په سیمه‌ییزه کچه د سولې د پراختیا لارې

paras.text: Many methods can be used to promote peace in a regional or local community. Today’s communities have not remained traditional communities. Because of many factors social changes are appearing everywhere. A change in human behaviour is being felt. However, even so, one method for the establishment of peace at the local level is forming associations. It is the responsibility of the educated people of the area that, to end the hatreds and clashes present in the community, associations be formed where many people are active voluntarily for the pleasure of Allah. Elders, by forming jirgas, can do much for peace. Cooperation can be taken from government institutions. Many steps can be taken to awaken consciousness. … pressure and interest groups and other human group activities awakened the Pakistani public, and because of this social movements began here too.

Ways of Promoting Peace at Local Level

Many methods can be used to promote peace in a regional or local community. Today’s communities have not remained traditional communities. Because of many factors social changes are appearing everywhere. A change in human behaviour is being felt. However, even so, one method for the establishment of peace at the local level is forming associations. It is the responsibility of the educated people of the area that, to end the hatreds and clashes present in the community, associations be formed where many people are active voluntarily for the pleasure of Allah. Elders, by forming jirgas, can do much for peace. Cooperation can be taken from government institutions. Many steps can be taken to awaken consciousness. These same associations can arrange sports, and other healthy recreational activities can be started where people can spend their leisure moments and their thinking remains constructive instead of destructive.

The most important role in unrest is that of ignorance and illiteracy. In educated societies there is peace and in ignorant societies unrest. This too is a method, that efforts be made for the promotion of education at the local level. Collectively people can be persuaded to send their sons and daughters to educational institutions. If a few educated people run a campaign with resolve and zeal, the condition of the area can be changed. In leisure moments arrangements for free tuition can be made. Parents can be motivated by different methods. Poor able students can be helped financially. The important thing is that people be made aware of the evils of unrest and the benefits of peace. Preaching non-violence is very necessary; for this purpose the educated young people of the community should adopt the ideas of those great people of the world who served society through non-violence. In today’s modern age preaching non-violence is certainly easy. In society people will have to be taught tolerance, acceptance and forbearance. For this, political parties, media, the mosque and ulema, educational institutions and other social institutions can play a full role. Every individual will have to show broad-mindedness and persuade others with argument, not by force and power. Problems are never solved with the gun …
